TV Share
Windows treats this Wi-Fi as public. If your TV can't find this PC, set it to Private (only on your home network).
New: official movie posters. TV Share can look your movies up on TMDB for posters, plot and rating. Only titles and years are sent.

Movie night,
on your TV.

One-time setup: TV Share needs two free, open-source helpers. It gets them from their official sites (about 150 MB). Allow a few minutes on a slow connection.

  • rcloneShows your movie folder to the TV
  • FFmpegPosters, and subtitles the TV can show

    Watch on your TV

    1. Turn on Share with TV (top right) and keep this app open, with the PC awake, on the same Wi-Fi as the TV.
    2. On the TV, open VLC. It's free in the TV's app store.
    3. Go to Browse → Local network → your PC and pick a movie.
    Movie won't start, or VLC jumps to another file? VLC is resuming it from the very end. Long-press the movie in VLC and choose Play from start.

    Rename your PC or change the movie folder in .

    Also works with Kodi, game consoles and most smart-TV media players. The first time, if Windows asks whether to allow network access, click Allow.
